test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The boy was punished ______ his disobedience.
solution:
The correct answer is '**for**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**for**" is used to indicate a reason or cause.
 
• In this context, the boy was punished due to his disobedience, so "**for**" is the most appropriate choice.
 
• **Options 1, 3**, and 4 are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The boy was punished **for**__ his disobedience."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "in"** is incorrect because "in" does not convey the sense of a reason or cause.
 
• **Option 3: "to"** is incorrect because "to" does not fit the sentence structure or meaning here.
 
• **Option 4: "at"** is incorrect because "at" is used to indicate a location or time, not a reason.
